title: Juicy Filipino Chinese Kaldereta
description: Rich and gooey Filipino dish featuring Chinese long beans, perfect for a date night. High in protein and flavor.
instructions: Heat butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the bamboo shoots and Chinese long beans to the pan and sauté for another 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, patis, soy sauce, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pork back into the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and serve hot, garnished with patent blue peppercorns.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles if desired.
Note: You can also grill the pork and vegetables on a yakimono grill for added smoky flavor.
